questions.q: When does the guardian teach the child to pray?
questions.e: The guardian is commanded to teach the child to pray at seven years old.

questions.q: What else does the guardian teach the child?
o: The Glorious Qur’an and good literature
questions.e: He teaches the Qur’an, literature and the wisdom the child can understand.

questions.q: How many messengers are there according to the book?
questions.e: The messengers sent by Allah number three hundred and thirteen.

questions.q: Who is the first messenger?
questions.e: The first is Adam, peace be upon him, a messenger to his children.

questions.q: To whom was the Zabur revealed?
questions.e: The Zabur to Dawud, the Torah to Musa and the Injil to ‘Isa.

questions.q: What is the greatest blessing Allah gave us?
questions.e: Among Allah’s blessings: existence, health, and the greatest, Islam.

questions.q: How many rak‘ahs are in the Maghrib prayer?
questions.e: Maghrib has three obligatory rak‘ahs.

questions.q: What do we say in rukū‘ (bowing)?
o: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High
Glory be to my Lord, the Most Great
Our Lord, and to You belongs all praise
questions.e: In bowing one says “Glory be to my Lord, the Most Great” three times.

questions.q: On how many parts of the body is sujūd done?
questions.e: Prostration is on seven parts: the forehead, hands, knees and feet.

questions.q: What does a traveller do with Dhuhr?
questions.e: The traveller shortens Dhuhr, Asr and Isha to two rak‘ahs each.

questions.q: How many takbirs are in the Eid prayer besides the prayer’s own takbirs?
questions.e: Thirteen takbirs besides the takbirs of the prayer.

questions.q: How many times do we wash the face in wudu?
questions.e: The face is washed three times.

questions.q: With which foot do we enter the toilet?
questions.e: Enter with the left foot and leave with the right.

questions.q: If we find no water, what do we do?
questions.e: If there is no water, one does tayammum with clean earth.

questions.q: What is the qiblah we face in prayer?
questions.e: The qiblah is the honoured Kaaba; prayer is not complete without facing it.

questions.q: How many takbirs are in the funeral prayer?
questions.e: The funeral prayer has four takbirs.

questions.q: On which side is the deceased laid in the grave?
questions.e: The deceased is laid on the right side facing the qiblah.

questions.q: When is the intention for Ramadan fasting made?
questions.e: One intends at night; whoever does not has no fast.

questions.q: What is the ruling on fasting on the day of Eid?
questions.e: Fasting on the two Eids is forbidden.

questions.q: What are the white days?
questions.e: The white days are the 13th, 14th and 15th of the month.

questions.q: How do we call our father?
questions.e: Calling one’s father by name is disrespectful; one says “O my father”.

questions.q: How many days is hospitality?
questions.e: Hospitality is three days; beyond that is charity.

questions.q: What is the best way to keep ties with relatives?
questions.e: The best tie is giving gifts, and the least is sending greetings.

questions.q: What is the minimum amount (nisab) of silver?
questions.e: Zakah is due on silver when it reaches two hundred dirhams.

questions.q: When is Zakat al-Fitr given?
o: On Eid day before going to the prayer
questions.e: Its time is from dawn on Eid day until going out to the prayer.

questions.q: How many categories are entitled to zakah?
questions.e: The categories entitled to zakah are eight.

questions.q: How many times in a lifetime is Hajj obligatory?
questions.e: Hajj is obligatory once in a lifetime; more is voluntary.

questions.q: How many circuits are in tawaf?
questions.e: Tawaf is seven circuits.

questions.q: Where does the sa‘i begin?
questions.e: It begins at Safa and ends at Marwah.

questions.q: With what was jihad prescribed?
questions.e: Jihad is worship prescribed with one’s self and wealth.

questions.q: What is arrogance?
o: Looking down on people and rejecting the truth
questions.e: Arrogance is to look down on people and reject the truth.

questions.q: What is the difference between envy and admiration (ghibtah)?
o: Admiration is wishing for the same blessing without it leaving the other
Admiration is forbidden and envy allowed
questions.e: Wishing for a blessing like another’s is allowed and is called ghibtah.

questions.q: What is the cure for showing off?
o: Knowing that people cannot bring benefit or harm
Doing more in front of people
questions.e: Its cure is knowing that people cannot benefit or harm; that is Allah alone.
